concept: K3 – J1 v podstavci (STS3215 stojí v osi J1 nad ľavým N20, sokel Ø75 do otvoreného dna trupu)
frame: world mm, Z up, floor z=0, FRONT=-Y, robot RIGHT=-X. Torso slices in the torso frame (J1=0); pan-stage (P) and lift (L) parts swept over pan -85..+85 (5 deg) and lift 0/10/20; static base parts that rise into the torso (plinth, J1 bearing, J1 loop, J1 servo top) swept over J1 -150..+150. Base slices in the base frame. Every extent already includes +1.0 mm clearance. The shell INNER surface must enclose each slice (hull_plus_1mm); add the wall (>= 2.0) outside. Parts marked shell_mounted touch the shell on purpose.

torso_top.collar: B collar disc r 26.5 (pan, z Z_TT-6..Z_TT) in the static ring r 26.75..28.25 glued in a recess r 28.35 through the torso top wall; flush with the torso top
torso_top.flat_zone: torso top flat (z = Z_TT) at least to r 30 around the axis
torso_top.head_keepout: beyond r 30 keep the B-verified shoulder: surface drops >= 1.6 mm at |y| 32, >= 3.7 at 33, >= 12 at 35 below Z_TT (or re-run the head sweep)
torso_top.pan_well_sweep: nothing static inside r 28.0 from z 86.8 to 127.8 (well + collar sweep r 26.9)

torso_bottom_J1.open_bottom: torso bottom OPEN: no torso material inside r 38.8 between z 40 and the torso deck underside z 65.2 (static dark plinth r 37.5 rises to z 58.6, J1 bearing seat r 23.5 to z 64.9). Visible dark plinth ring = R01 'dark gap ring'.
torso_bottom_J1.torso_deck: z 65.2..67.2, screwed to >= 4 internal bosses of the torso shell
torso_bottom_J1.J1_bearing: 6806-2RS 30x42x7 at z 57.9..64.9 on the axis (outer ring static in the plinth)
torso_bottom_J1.J1_loop: FPC rolling loop annulus r 24..36, z 59.7..64.7; rotating outer wall r 36.5..37.6, z 59.6..65.2

shoulders.spline_hole: r 4 through the torso wall at x +-(43.5..46)
shoulders.arm_sweep: paddle 30 (y) x 21 (x) x 80 (14 above / 66 below the axis) turning about X; range -45..+180 (head-dependent firmware limit, see check.json arm table); torso surface must stay at |x| <= 46.0 inside r 70 of the axis
shoulders.arm_min_interior: x 17.7 (servo case 15.5 + tabs, 1.8 walls), y 13.2 half, see arm slices

base.outline: pebble 148 x 118 (superellipse n 2.4 placeholder), z 6..40, ground clearance 6
base.wheel_openings: floor slots 12 x 30 at x +-56.5 (wheels D30 x 9, x +-(52..61), axle z 15, protrude 6)
base.caster_openings: D14 at (+-46, +-30) – Pololu 3/8in ball casters, ball 0.5 mm above the wheel contact plane

base.power_switch: back wall x -22, z 33.5 (lever slot 5 x 2.5)
base.charge_LED: on the IP2326 board next to the USB-C (light pipe in the port opening)
